override_reasons.ebit_margin: Held near 2025's 12.6% GAAP operating margin less a little for the lower 2026 ad base; FY26 adjusted EBITDA guide $320–325m with SBC ~7% and D&A ~5% of revenue implies ~10–11%.
override_reasons.terminal_growth: 1% rather than 2.5%: core advertising is shrinking (ad clicks -8% in Q3) and AI search is diverting local traffic.

Stabilisation.description: Ad decline bottoms out; AI products and data licensing reach the $250m run-rate target.

Structural decline.description: AI answers keep cutting local-search clicks: revenue -4% a year, margins compress to 8%.
